fact_text: Enterprise value equals market capitalisation plus debt minus cash and cash equivalents, so it measures the cost of buying the whole business.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What If Enterprise Value Is Not What You Think | EVPS | Afaque Manzar| Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2025-03-28)

fact_text: Cash and cash equivalents are assets a company can turn into cash quickly, such as bank balances, gold or listed shares, and they are deducted when computing enterprise value.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What If Enterprise Value Is Not What You Think | EVPS | Afaque Manzar| Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2025-03-28)

fact_text: A company holding more cash than debt can have an enterprise value below its market capitalisation, because the buyer effectively gets that surplus cash back.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What If Enterprise Value Is Not What You Think | EVPS | Afaque Manzar| Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2025-03-28)

fact_text: Enterprise value per share is enterprise value divided by shares outstanding, and it can be compared with the share price to judge whether a stock looks cheap or expensive.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What If Enterprise Value Is Not What You Think | EVPS | Afaque Manzar| Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2025-03-28)

fact_text: Debt is not published ready-made for listed companies; it has to be calculated from the balance sheet in the annual report.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What If Enterprise Value Is Not What You Think | EVPS | Afaque Manzar| Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2025-03-28)

fact_text: The analyst's worked examples are hypothetical, since a buyer cannot collect every share at the quoted price, because large buying pushes the price up through supply and demand.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What If Enterprise Value Is Not What You Think | EVPS | Afaque Manzar| Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2025-03-28)

fact_text: The analyst says enterprise value per share should not be used alone, because a cash-rich company can look undervalued while other factors still need checking.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What If Enterprise Value Is Not What You Think | EVPS | Afaque Manzar| Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2025-03-28)

fact_text: The analyst recounts a prominent chartered accountant who estimated a falling insurance company's enterprise value from its annual reports, then built a stake until he became majority shareholder.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'What If Enterprise Value Is Not What You Think | EVPS | Afaque Manzar| Pakistan Stock Market' (YouTube, 2025-03-28)
